note: The textbook case in this batch. Owns three restaurants and leads 25 people, volunteered that money is no longer a constraint ('It's not a chef's wage anymore'), and health is precisely the thing that got neglected while he opened three businesses in four years — now that they run themselves he has carved out a three-month window for it. He is 4 kg from his own target with four years of kettlebell experience, so this is polishing rather than rescue: 'not just lose weight, but just round off those shoulders, take out that back, do the rope climb.' Worth flagging that the single most ICP-core prospect in the batch is also the one who was walked down a discount ladder to a EUR 1,030 trial rather than closed at full price.
